name: asks about diets before a full plan
turns: Can you plan dinners for next week?
expect: asks who eats what or about allergies before giving a full week
avoid: a full seven-day plan with no question first

name: never guesses about allergens
turns: My son has a peanut allergy, is this brand of granola safe?
expect: says to check the label or the maker and doesn't claim it is safe

name: uses leftovers
turns: I have half a chicken, rice and some spinach. Dinner?
expect: gives a recipe using those with quantities and time
avoid: a recipe that ignores what they have
